user_story: As a user, I want my password reset token to be invalidated after use so that it cannot be reused.

positive.title: Validate password reset token after first use
steps: 2. Use the password reset token to reset the password.
3. Attempt to use the same token again to reset the password.
positive.expected_result: The system should return an error message indicating that the token is invalid.

negative.title: Attempt using an expired password reset token
steps: 2. Wait for the token to expire.
3. Attempt to use the expired token to reset the password.
negative.expected_result: The system should return an error message indicating that the token is expired.

edge.title: Validate token invalidation when used with simultaneous requests
steps: 2. At the same time, submit two separate requests to reset the password using the same token.
3. Verify the results of both attempts.
edge.expected_result: One of the password reset requests should succeed while the other should fail with an invalid token error.
